niche: connected TV and streaming advertising agency
prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” connected TV (CTV) advertising agency — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, scale, creative needs, preferred buying method (direct vs programmatic), measurement requirements, and region. Below is a short guide to help you choose plus a shortlist of well-regarded players by type.

What to consider
- Objective: brand awareness, reach, frequency, direct-response / conversions, or advanced measurement (attribution/ATV)?
- Budget & scale: national vs regional vs test campaign.
- Inventory preference: premium publisher deals (Netflix/Hulu/Disney) vs device-specific (Roku/Samsung) vs programmatic exchanges.
- Measurement & attribution needs: third‑party measurement, deterministic household matching, or post‑view conversions?
- Creative capabilities: do you need CTV-specific creative/ad personalization and dynamic insertion?
- Reporting cadence & transparency: access to raw impression-level data, viewability, verification (IVT).

Who to look at (shortlist by category)
- Large holding-company media agencies (best for big brands, integrated cross-channel planning and premium buying):
  - GroupM (Wavemaker, Mindshare), Omnicom Media Group (OMD, PHD, Hearts & Science), Publicis Media (Starcom, Zenith), Dentsu (Carat), IPG (UM, Initiative)

- Independent CTV / video specialists (best for performance, innovation, or if you want boutique expertise):
  - Simulmedia — audience-driven TV + CTV optimization
  - MNTN — performance-focused CTV (direct-response, measurable outcomes)
  - Tremor / Tremor Video — video ad platform and programmatic video
  - Amobee — unified TV + digital buying with cross-channel measurement

- Platforms and tech partners you’ll commonly use (not traditional agencies but essential for CTV scale/measurement):
  - The Trade Desk — leading programmatic DSP for CTV buyers
  - Roku OneView, Samsung Ads, Amazon DSP — powerful publisher/platform DSPs with first‑party inventory and attribution
  - Innovid — creative/ad-serving and measurement for CTV
  - Magnite, PubMatic — supply-side partners for programmatic CTV inventory

How to pick (quick checklist / RFP questions)
- Can you show case studies for campaigns with goals like mine (KPIs and results)?
- What inventory partners and device/platforms do you access (publisher direct, private marketplace, open exchange)?
- How do you measure reach, frequency, viewability, and conversions? Which verification vendors do you use?
- What level of creative support do you provide (30s/15s/interactive/dynamic creative)?
- What reporting will I get and how often? Will I have access to impression-level logs?
- Fee structure: media margin vs percentage vs flat fee vs platform costs?

Recommendation / next step
If you tell me your goals, target audience, geography, and approximate monthly or campaign budget, I’ll recommend 2–3 agencies/platforms that are a good fit and explain why.
